scope: Source-only clarification of existing processing-order implementation, no new engine edit or GPU action.
facts: Existing layer-major mode rejects nonzero KV mode, so it cannot be enabled unchanged for the current streamed256K geometry.
Existing layer-major code already loads every expert of the current layer into a temporary GPU cache, supplies a per-layer residency map, and calls run_impl for that layer.
The regular compute path uses resident cached blob pointers and skips staging those experts. A proposal based on assuming that layer-major still transfers every weight for every chunk would be wrong.
After the upstream comparison, use actual no-API phase/copy measurements to choose the next optimization; do not infer PCIe dominance from raw bandwidth alone.
